# Conextsol — Web Design & Development Cape Town & South Africa
> Cape Town's premier results-driven web design, web development, custom software development, Google Ads management, and managed website hosting studio serving South African businesses nationwide.

## About
Conextsol is headquartered in Cape Town, South Africa, serving clients in Cape Town, Johannesburg, Durban, Pretoria, and across South Africa. We build fast, beautiful, high-converting websites and custom software applications for South African SMEs, startups, and professional service firms.

## Services Overview
- Website Design (/services/website-design): Beautiful, mobile-first, high-converting websites designed to establish your brand and drive actual business results in Cape Town and across South Africa.
- Web Development (/services/web-development): Robust, scalable, sub-2-second front-end and back-end web application development using modern stacks (React, Next.js, Node.js).
- Custom Software Development (/services/custom-software-development): Bespoke web applications, CRMs, client portals, and internal tools engineered specifically to automate business workflows.
- UI/UX Design (/services/ui-ux-design): Data-driven user experience and interface design created in Figma to maximize user conversion and satisfaction.
- E-commerce Development (/services/ecommerce-development): High-performance online stores integrated with local South African payment gateways (PayFast, Peach Payments, Yoco) and couriers.
- Website Maintenance & Optimization (/services/website-maintenance): 24/7 uptime monitoring, daily backups, security patching, and ongoing performance optimization.
- Google Ads Management (/services/google-ads-management): In-house Google Search and Display campaign setup, PPC keyword targeting, and conversion tracking for South African businesses.
- Managed Website Hosting (/services/hosting): Secure cloud hosting resold via tier-1 third-party infrastructure partners, fully managed by Conextsol with free SSL and 24/7 monitoring.
